app.name: Nordwin Attendance
app.description: Attendance, overtime and leave for Nordwin Textiles Ltd.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell IT what you were doing.
errors.network: Can't reach the attendance server. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.unavailable: The attendance server isn't responding. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.server: The server ran into a problem. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell IT.
errors.serverWithReference: The server ran into a problem. Try again; if it keeps happening, give IT this reference: {reference}.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this. Ask HR or IT if you need it.
errors.notFound: That record no longer exists. Reload the page to see the current data.

validation.code: Use up to {max} letters, digits or - _ . /, starting with a letter or digit.
validation.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
validation.phone: Use digits, spaces or dashes, optionally starting with +.
validation.date: Enter a full date: day, month and year.
validation.minimumAge: The employee must be at least {years} on the joining date. Check the date of birth and joining date.
validation.confirmationBeforeJoining: The confirmation date can't be before the joining date.
validation.passwordMismatch: The passwords don't match. Type the new password again.
validation.passwordSame: Choose a password that is different from your current one.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your work email and password.
login.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an active account. Check both and try again. After 5 failed attempts the account locks for 15 minutes.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts from this network. Wait a minute, then try again.

reason.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to carry on where you were.
reason.unavailable: The attendance server didn't respond, so your session couldn't be renewed. Try signing in again.
reason.password-changed: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your work email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. It can be used once. Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or ask HR to reset your password.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a password you don't use anywhere else.
reset.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.

errors.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or request a new one.

change.title: Change your password
change.subtitle: Enter your current password, then the new one twice.
change.forced: You need to set a new password before you can continue.
change.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

search.trigger: Search employees or jump to a screen…
search.title: Search
search.description: Find an employee by code or name, or jump to a screen.
search.hint: Type at least 2 characters to search employees.
search.empty: No employee or screen matches. Check the spelling, or search by employee code.

desktopOnly.title: Open this on a larger screen
desktopOnly.body: Setup and master-data screens need a desktop or laptop. On a phone, use the punch, attendance and leave screens instead.

list.title: Employees
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No employees} one {# employee} other {# employees}}
list.caption: Employees, sortable by code, name, department, designation and joining date
list.emptyFiltered: No employees match these filters. Clear a filter, or search by employee code.

detail.newDescription: Fill in both tabs. No login account is created; floor workers who only punch on a device don't need one.
detail.notFound: This employee doesn't exist, or isn't in your part of the organization. Check the link, or find them in the employee list.

account.no: No login (punches on a device only)

shift.title: No shift assigned yet
shift.body: The default shift, roster and weekly-off pattern are set here once the Shift module is switched on.

leave.title: No leave balances yet
leave.body: Balances by leave type appear here once leave types are set up in the Leave module.

documents.title: No documents yet
documents.body: Contracts and other files can be attached here once document storage is switched on.

form.emailHint: Optional. Used for notifications and password resets.
form.confirmationHint: Leave empty while the employee is on probation.

picker.empty: No active employee matches. Search by employee code or part of the name.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.description: Their attendance, leave and overtime history is kept. They can be reactivated later.
deactivate.descriptionWithLogin: Their attendance, leave and overtime history is kept, and their login is switched off so they can no longer sign in. They can be reactivated later.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.description: The separation date is cleared and they can be rostered and paid again.
reactivate.descriptionWithLogin: The separation date is cleared. Their login stays switched off until IT turns it back on in user management.

org.title: Departments & designations
org.description: The organization structure employees are assigned to. Records are retired, never deleted.

departments.caption: Departments
departments.emptyFiltered: No department matches. Search by code or part of the name.

empty.active: No active departments. Add one to start assigning employees.
empty.all: No departments yet. Add one to start assigning employees.

departments.headHint: Optional. An active employee in your part of the organization.

retire.title: Retire {name}?
retire.description: It stays in employees' history but can't be assigned any more. Move its active employees and sub-departments first, or the retirement is refused.

restore.title: Restore {name}?
restore.description: It can be assigned to employees and sub-departments again.

designations.caption: Designations
designations.emptyFiltered: No designation matches. Search by code, name or grade.

empty.active: No active designations. Add one to start assigning employees.
empty.all: No designations yet. Add one to start assigning employees.

retire.title: Retire {name}?
retire.description: It stays in employees' history but can't be assigned any more. Give its active employees another designation first, or the retirement is refused.

restore.title: Restore {name}?
restore.description: It can be assigned to employees again.

notFound.title: There's nothing at this address
notFound.body: The link may be mistyped, or the screen may not exist yet.
